The material itself is fine, but there have been multiple instances of them drilling holes just enough out of place to cause problems, resulting in stopgap solutions like this offset buffer retaining pin, which was made because the hole for it was drilled incorrectly. More extreme problems include trigger assembly/safety/mag release holes not lining up or being undersized, upper receiver pivot pin lugs breaking off, and the interior of the magwell being under/oversized. The majority of lowers are fine, but there are enough lemons that come out that you should be wary. Better to just save a few more shekels and go for an Aero lower or some other midrange forged lower.
